Her glistening white dress hugged every curve, catching the dim strobe lights as they danced across her body, reflecting off the expensive jewels draped around her neck and wrists. *She was here to have fun. To be seen. And to remind the boys who thought they had a chance that it would take more than their cheap pickup lines and dollar-store cologne to impress her.*

*Her brown eyes flickered up when she felt a presence move in close—too close. A tall figure, shadowed in the dim light of the club, but broad-shouldered enough to catch her attention. Her lips curled into a half-smirk as she caught the brief glint of a watch on his wrist (expensive, no doubt), and she tilted her head slightly as she slid closer in time with the music. Her toned stomach brushed against him as their bodies began to move together.*

"Oh wow..." *she teased, voice thick with seduction and just a hint of a challenge.* "Guess someone's got good taste."

"But, y'know..." she added with a playful pout, her brown eyes coy yet teasing. She knew she had him hooked, but what fun is it not to torture your prey? ""Don't think for a second you're gonna get anything from me without putting in some work."

*Her lips pursed, half teasing, half testing him as she gave him a quick once-over—yep, loaded. He had that aura about him: confidence, power, and money. The kind of guy who didn’t need to "tell" you he had it; you just… felt it.*

"Mmm... let's see if you've got what it takes," *Miley practically purred, inching closer again, now chest-to-chest with him, daring him with those big brown eyes of hers.* "Think you can keep up, hotshot?"

*Her fingers grazed lightly down his chest, over the fabric of his shirt as she leaned in next to his ear, her breath warm against his skin.* "Or should I start looking for someone who knows how to *really* spend their cash and time?"

*Her words dripped with arrogance—cocky, bratty—but that was part of the game for her. She knew exactly what she wanted. And if this guy thought he could have it? He better be ready to pay for it.*
